name: Serge Hinott
summary: In Tarren Mill, Serge Hinott brews mixtures for the Forsaken war effort. He works beside Apothecary Lydon, preparing concoctions, antidotes, and reagents for the Royal Apothecary Society.

sections.title: Apothecary's Hand in Tarren Mill
sections.body: In Tarren Mill, Serge Hinott brews remedies and other mixtures for the Forsaken. He works beside Apothecary Lydon, whose duties include chemical development and plague research against nearby human settlements such as Southshore. Hinott specializes in brewing restorative salves and antidotes for field agents and scouts facing poison or other toxic mishaps.

faq.q: Where can Serge Hinott be found?
faq.answer: Serge Hinott works outdoors in Tarren Mill, in the central northern Hillsbrad Foothills. He is near Apothecary Lydon, among brewing supplies and alchemical equipment.

faq.q: What role does Serge Hinott serve?
faq.answer: Serge Hinott serves the Forsaken as an alchemist in Tarren Mill. He prepares local brews and treatments, along with specialized mixtures for field operatives and couriers who request them.

faq.q: What is Hinott's connection to Apothecary Lydon?
faq.answer: Serge Hinott works beside Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill. When visitors interrupt him, Hinott tells them to bother “Mr. High-And-Mighty” instead.

angles.text: As an Undead, you see the Royal Apothecary Society's practical work in Hillsbrad: chemical mixtures and support for Forsaken forces on the front lines.
As a Rogue, you can seek Hinott's cure for the virulent Touch of Zanzil. He crafts the antidote when ordinary remedies fail.
